title: Build a small language-model runtime
lead: Build the small numerical path first, then adapt it to one pinned pretrained decoder. Deliver real generated tokens, compare cached computation and investigate a content-valid cache discrepancy.
prerequisites: JavaScript arrays, functions, objects and ES modules; matrix multiplication and dimensions. A complete numeric backend is supplied; the tensor course is optional.
scope: Original PocketDecoder-v1 is the earlier numerical teaching slice. The one trained final profile is pinned Stories260K:5blocks,dim64,8query/4KVheads,512-token BPE,context512,CPUbinary64. Checked binary/tokenizer loading, RMSNorm/RoPE/gatedMLP, cache, seeded streaming and bounded beam extension. No GPU, training, quantization, hosted inference or model zoo.
runtime: Node 22+ advertised; tested on Node 26.5.1 only. No API key, account, network or dependency install.
